binding.process_identity: Exact existing initialized queue identity; all fields same values. Bind initialization only after ordinary durable init ACK was actually delivered.
binding.request_hash: Go canonical prepared resource_effects request_hash; worker matches original effect sequence/key and initialized binding; raw request not reconstructed from an invented secret revision.

stream.data.offset: cumulative original bytes after this fragment
stream.data.digest: SHA256 of all original bytes through offset
stream.data.terminal_note: terminal=true data is withheld from SDK until exact ordinary effect ACK arrives; may include withheld secret-prefix bytes before DONE. All terminal=true data sent ONLY after original CONFIRMED effect is durable.

payload.observation_sequence: latest actually durable observation at send; final closure may add staged END/message_end observations

payload.journal_event_ids: array of committed original outbox ids, empty for staged ends

stream.observe.offset: cumulative visible text delta UTF8 bytes; zero-byte start/end do not advance
stream.observe.digest: sha256(canonicalJSON({previous: previous_digest, payload: exact_payload})); initial previous=sha256(empty bytes)

payload.text_part: dense visible-text part index,0..63; message_end uses0
payload.sdk_content_index: actual SDK content index; message_end uses0
payload.text: real delta or empty for other events

terminal_handshake: Go sends open before data; worker resolves streaming fetch to Response immediately, original effect promise stays pending. Go reads/quarantines exact SSE, persists original CONFIRMED fact, sends terminal=true remaining bytes with transport credit, then stream.terminal marker, then returns ordinary ACK through original ordered pump. Worker validates marker/ACK exactmatch and original digest before exposing withheld bytes/EOF. Real SDK text_end stays staged, public END only on final verified result artifact+Run settlement. message_end observe drains/closes active stream after durable credit; next MODEL may then open. Credits NEVER acknowledge original frames or commands. Aborted ordinary ACK identities stay retained.
backpressure: Hook onProviderStreamEvent awaits previous actual SDK push sequence consumed. Wrap returned SDK stream push with a bounded counter and async iterator whose post-yield resumes only after actual awaited agent.subscribe processing. Chained existing hook unchanged. Zero-output batch adds no sequence; all multi-event batches counted. No waiting for current chunk future events. Bound pending raw transport and pending observations independently; all waits AbortSignal/deadline cancellable. One stdout chain and Go stdin writeMu.
